Name: Heled, Son of Baanah
Summary: Son of Baanah the Netophathite, one of David's valiant men.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 11:30: Son of Baanah the Netophathite, one of David's valiant men.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Heled stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
